title: Albany Business Review: The strategies Guin Gorman used to grow Grace Roofing
summary: Guin Gorman transformed Grace Roofing from $150,000 in annual revenue to a multimillion-dollar operation.
body_markdown:
The Gormans have invested roughly $750,000 in the former restaurant and commercial property since purchasing it in 2021, including renovations to the main building and construction of a two-story garage for storage and office space.


Pioneer has provided financing for the garage project, as well as a line of credit to help manage seasonal fluctuations in the roofing business."


[Read the full story covered by Luke Nathan in the Albany Business Review here.](https://www.bizjournals.com/albany/news/2026/09/06/grace-roofing-guin-gorman.html)
